cause.label: dilution_or_going_concern
cause.what_happened: Today is the third leg of a slide that began after the 1-for-15 reverse split took effect on Oct 5. Today the stock gapped down 15.65% at the open and held flat intraday on 8.2x normal volume. That followed a 42.9% fall on Oct 12, the first session after the Oct 9 17:03 ET 8-K. That 8-K disclosed 128,965 conversion shares issued to J.J. Astor and a non-binding LOI to buy Direct Midstream, mostly paid in $29m of Series B preferred, with a $10m cash investment it gives no source for. No 8-K or news has been filed since, so the converter-selling cause is inferred from filings, not confirmed for today.

evidence.claim: 128,965 unlegended shares issued to J.J. Astor on Oct 5-6, 2026 on conversion of $350,000 of the junior secured note ($5.94m original principal). The same 8-K furnishes the Direct Midstream LOI press release.
LOI: $40m gross price; about $29m in Series B Preferred and $1m in common stock; Vivakor to fund a $10m capital investment at closing, with no funding source stated; non-binding, no target dates.
1-for-15 reverse split effective at the open on Oct 5, 2026. It is the second of 2026, after the 1-for-20 on July 17.
On Sept 2, 603,555 shares went to J.J. Astor and 40,116 to a holder of the Lender Notes ($5.12m original principal), both unlegended. That was about 7% of the ~8.98m pre-split share count in one day.

Resale prospectus for 40.5m conversion shares under the May 8, 2026 $15m convertible note SPA. The conversion price is the greater of a floor or 80% of the lowest daily VWAP over the prior 5 trading days. There is also a separate $100m SEPA that needs its own registration.
No EDGAR filing after the Oct 9 8-K as of the screen; the atom feed's latest entry is 2026-10-09 17:03 ET.

pipeline.next_dated_event: None found with a date inside the window. Item 3.02 8-Ks for conversions after Oct 6 have come 3-7 days after each batch (Sept 2 batch filed Sept 9; Oct 5-6 batch filed Oct 9), but no conversion after Oct 6 is sourced. Special dividend of Adapti stock moved to 2027-01-29.
pipeline.what_would_change_my_mind: A filing that the convertible notes were repaid, exchanged or capped, or a definitive Direct Midstream agreement with committed funding, before the Oct 14 close.

findings.finding: Supply from at least three convertible facilities is still converting into unlegended, freely saleable stock, priced off recent lows, with no sourced end. These are the J.J. Astor junior secured note ($5.94m), the Lender Notes ($5.12m) and the May 2026 $15m note programme at 80% of the lowest 5-day VWAP. The Oct 5-6 conversion alone was ~21% of the post-split share count.
findings.mechanism_in_window: Conversions are at the holders' discretion and have no blackout. Their price resets lower after every down session, so a holder can convert and sell on Oct 14. The last two disclosed batches came about five weeks apart (Sept 2 and Oct 5-6). Today's 8.2x volume, about 430k shares against a ~0.73m post-conversion count, fits fresh conversion stock being sold, but no conversion after Oct 6 is sourced.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After the Sept 9 3.02 8-K (Sept 2 conversions), the baseline shows a -12.3% fall on Sept 4 followed by +7.65% next close, and -11.1% on Sept 14 followed by -7.06%. After the Oct 9 8-K: -42.9% on Oct 12 and about -14.7% on Oct 13 at the screen. Mixed next-day reactions to individual dilution days, under a persistent downtrend (-93.6% over 60 days).
findings.why_not_priced: The price has taken the dilution that is already disclosed. The 80%-of-lowest-VWAP formula means each further down day enlarges the next conversion, and the holders' sales lean on any bounce. That supply arrives tomorrow whatever today's close is. If it were priced, the stock would sit at a level the converters had already sold through, and today's flat intraday leg after the gap would show it. Nothing shows the overhang is spent, though the intraday hold is weak evidence the other way.
findings.independence: Same issuer, different documents: the July 2026 424B3 sets out the 80%-of-lowest-5-day-VWAP pricing (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1450704/000182912626007718/vivakor_424b3.htm). A secondary page notes the authorized share count was left unchanged by the split, leaving room for issuance (https://stockstotrade.com/news/vivakorinc-vivk-news-2026_10_09/).

outside_window.finding: Direct Midstream LOI requires Vivakor to fund a $10m capital investment at closing, with no source stated, and to issue ~$29m of Series B preferred. A definitive agreement or its financing would be a further dilution or financing event; no date is given.
A $100m Standby Equity Purchase Agreement exists but needs its own registration statement; none was filed as of the screen.
Former COO Patterson's consulting agreement, due by Oct 9, is to be paid in S-8 registered common stock. The share count is not disclosed; it is small supply.

Web search 'Vivakor shares fall October 12 2026' found no news item for Oct 12 or Oct 13; newest coverage is Oct 9 (Tickeron, StocksToTrade).
Repricing leg: no analyst coverage note, no disclosed buyer, no Form 4 buying (Nasdaq insider summary shows 0 trades in 12 months), no wire error found. No mechanism means no overshoot finding.
No price dated after the 15:05 ET screen instant was seen or used; search snippets carried only Oct 3 to Oct 9 prices.
